1-Rider Partylist expresses their deep gratitude to all riders who supported the *Bayanihan Para sa Kagulong* event held in Pritil, Manila, on July 24, 2025.

Despite relentless rain, widespread flooding, and challenges faced by riders unable to travel or impacted by the disaster, they united to distribute relief supplies. 

The organization extends its appreciation to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) for their swift response. 1-Rider Partylist is committed to delivering aid to other affected areas and will continue collaborating with various government agencies.
